text_markup: The Corp wins if the Runner is {term:flatlined}. The Runner is flatlined immediately if they suffer more damage than they have cards in their grip. See {ref:sec_damage} for information about damage. The Runner is also flatlined if, at the beginning of their discard step, their maximum hand size is less than 0. See {ref:sec_discard_phase} for information about maximum hand size and the discard step.
text_plain: The Corp wins if the Runner is flatlined. The Runner is flatlined immediately if they suffer more damage than they have cards in their grip. See section 10.4 for information about damage. The Runner is also flatlined if, at the beginning of their discard step, their maximum hand size is less than 0. See section 5.5 for information about maximum hand size and the discard step.
